method: Scraped all 1150 newest videos (watch-page viewCount + uploadDate), filtered to window, ranked by views. 64 rate-limited fetches retried via yt-dlp; all fell outside window.

thumbnails: Photorealistic AI-rendered CONCEPT products (aspirational, not real listings)
Composition: single hero product (5/10), 2-panel vertical split (4/10), 3-panel (1/10)
ZERO text on image (one exception: small 'available at amazon' white badge)
Amazon 'a' app-icon badge watermark in a corner or top-center (8/10)
Glow accents: LED strips, neon underglow, fire, backlit screens; warm-vs-cool contrast
One saturated hero color against neutral interior (yellow/green/pink-blue/gold)
Human presence for scale in ~half (lounging man, sleeping woman, hand, foot)
Products show working displays with readable times (00:20, 09:58, 12:30)
Seniors content: gold+black luxury palette, warm lamp-lit living room
style_dna.titles: [odd number] + [Amazon/Temu] + [category] + Gadgets/Finds/Upgrades + [benefit or FOMO clause] + [year | emoji | *tag*], CAPS emphasis words (NEW/FAST/SO/GENIUS), trailing '..' for curiosity variants
